Report Transformation

The Report Transformation form configures parameters for custom report transformations.

Set options to apply transformation rules and generate derived financial reports.

Description

Add an optional description or note that will appear on the report.

From

The starting date for the report period.

To

The ending date for the report period.

Accounting method

Select whether to use accrual or cash basis accounting for this report.

Employee

Select a specific employee to filter the report data.
